_doc: Cortex autonomy config. Copy to .cortex/autonomy.json for project-level or ~/.claude/cortex-autonomy.json for global. Presets: supervised (all gates active), gates-only (approval gates only), full-auto (mandatory gates only).

_gates_doc.mandatory: ux_taste_eval, human_action, reclarify — cannot be disabled by any preset or per-gate override
_gates_doc.approval: contract_approval, spec_approval, eval_approval — active in supervised + gates-only presets
_gates_doc.review: slug_conflict, eval_proposal, critical_uncertainty, evidence_backing, compliance_verdict, eval_validation, security_verdict — active in supervised preset only
